body.name: Conf
body.def: On \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), the Bonferroni collection uses the explicit block-constrained maps \(L_E(S_n)\), the resulting rational effect maps, and their delta-method derivatives on the positive-definite cone; on \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), it is the deterministic collection of full real-line intervals.
